changeLog: Added new features and bug fixes!
siteChangeLog:
• Event Focus Mode: Fullscreen drawing canvas with distraction-free sketching.
• Live Collaboration: Real-time event walls, host curtain reveal, and Event Library.
• Faster Sharing: One-tap Copy Code, invite links, and shareable event QR cards.
• UI/UX Revamp: Crisp SVG icons across Events & Notifications and responsive 2-column action grids.
• Exit Protection: Smart back navigation closes open modals first and confirms before closing the app.
